name: Simple Account Switcher
description: Simple program to clear linked PSN account so you can login to a new one.
long_description:
Simple program to clear linked PSN account so you can login to a new one.

Note: this download is hosted on an external server, not GitHub, and may stop working if that server goes down or changes without the catalog knowing.
requirements: Requires a jailbroken PS Vita/PSTV and installation of the VPK via VitaShell (or compatible package installer).
